claim_en: THE CONDITION AND THE SIX BLESSINGS: IF YOU DILIGENTLY HEARKEN TO THE VOICE OF THE LORD YOUR GOD TO KEEP AND DO ALL HIS COMMANDMENTS, HE SETS YOU HIGH ABOVE ALL THE NATIONS; ALL THESE BLESSINGS COME ON YOU AND OVERTAKE YOU: BLESSED IN THE CITY AND IN THE FIELD; THE FRUIT OF YOUR WOMB, YOUR GROUND AND YOUR BEAST; YOUR BASKET AND YOUR KNEADING TROUGH; YOUR COMING IN AND YOUR GOING OUT. The Sifrei: the six blessings the house's seats — the store, the dough, coming and going, eating and satisfaction, the innards (40:10); 15:6's 'as He spoke to you' is 28:3 (116:1). Onkelos: receive the Memra, berikh, the sala, the offspring of your womb.

claim_en: THE HEAVENS' TREASURE, THE LENDING, THE HEAD AND NOT THE TAIL: THE LORD MAKES YOU ABOUND IN THE FRUIT OF WOMB, BEAST AND GROUND; HE OPENS HIS GOOD TREASURE, THE HEAVENS, TO GIVE YOUR LAND'S RAIN IN ITS SEASON; YOU LEND TO MANY NATIONS AND DO NOT BORROW; THE HEAD AND NOT THE TAIL, ABOVE AND NOT BENEATH — IF YOU TURN NOT RIGHT OR LEFT TO GO AFTER OTHER GODS TO SERVE THEM.
